note: Synthetic bilingual fixture. Every Entry and query is invented; there is no real personal data. A query's expected list holds the Entries a person would accept as the answer. An empty list means nothing in the archive should match.

entries.title: Climbing gym
entries.body: Met a guy at the climbing gym today who fixes bikes on the side. He tuned up my commuter bike for free.

entries.title: 攀岩馆
entries.body: 今天在攀岩馆认识了一个会修自行车的人，他免费帮我调了通勤的车。
The final round interview at the startup went well. The recruiter said I should hear about the offer by Friday.
今天创业公司的终面结束了，面试官很友好，说周五之前会通知我 offer 的结果。

entries.title: New place
entries.body: Signed the lease on a small apartment in Philadelphia. Boxes are stacked all over the living room.

entries.title: 新家
entries.body: 在费城签下了一间小公寓的租约，客厅里堆满了搬家的箱子。
Made grandma's dumpling recipe tonight and missed her so much.
今晚按外婆的方子包了饺子，特别想她。

entries.title: First half marathon
entries.body: Finished my first half marathon. My legs are destroyed but I am so proud.

entries.title: 半程马拉松
entries.body: 第一次跑完了半程马拉松，腿酸得不行，但是特别自豪。

entries.title: Study notes
entries.body: Compound interest means your earnings also earn interest, so money grows faster over time.

entries.title: 学习笔记
entries.body: 复利就是利滚利，赚到的收益本身也会继续生息，所以钱越滚越多。
Felt anxious all afternoon and could not focus. A long walk helped a little.
整个下午都很焦虑，没办法集中精神，散了很久的步之后好了一点。

entries.title: First time skiing
entries.body: My first time skiing. I fell a dozen times on the bunny slope but loved it.

entries.title: 第一次滑雪
entries.body: 第一次滑雪，在新手坡上摔了十几次，不过玩得很开心。
Tried making fresh pasta from scratch today. The dough was far too sticky.
今天第一次自己做手擀面，面团黏得根本没法擀。

entries.title: Book
entries.body: Finished a novel about a lighthouse keeper. The ending stayed with me all evening.

entries.title: 读书
entries.body: 读完了一本关于灯塔守护人的小说，结局让我整个晚上都忘不掉。

entries.title: Dana's wedding
entries.body: Flew to Seattle for Dana's wedding. The ceremony was held right by the water.

entries.title: 婚礼
entries.body: 飞到西雅图参加 Dana 的婚礼，仪式就在水边举行。
The old Civic would not start this morning. The battery was dead again.
那辆旧的思域今天早上发动不了，电瓶又没电了。
今天的 code review 收到了很多 comment，but I learned a lot about error handling.
周末和 Mia 去 farmers market 买了 tomatoes 和 basil，晚上做了 caprese salad。

entries.title: Weekend recap
entries.body:
We drove up to the lake on Saturday morning and set up the tent before noon. The water was cold, but we swam anyway and made a fire when it got dark.

Sunday I tried a pasta sauce on the camp stove and burned the garlic, which made everyone laugh. We ate it anyway, with too much cheese.

On the drive home I finished the last chapter of the lighthouse novel and stayed quiet for a while after.
Dentist appointment moved to Thursday morning. Need to remember to floss more.
Paid the electricity bill and renewed the internet plan for another year.
Rainy again. The forecast says it will stay gray all week.
Dropped off my passport photos at the pharmacy for the renewal form.
Watered the plants and repotted the fern on the balcony.
Got a haircut today, a bit shorter than I planned.
Laundry day: three loads, folded everything before dinner.
Found a parking ticket on the windshield after the meeting downtown.
今天去牙科复诊，医生说要多用牙线。
交了水电费，顺便续了宽带。
又下雨了，天气预报说这周都是阴天。
给阳台的绿植浇了水，还给蕨类换了盆。
